name: Dawn has opened the road
text:
Dawn has opened the road.
Rise.
Wake the oxen.
Gather the water.
Fold the tents.
The night has carried us this far.
The light will carry us farther.

inspired_by.source: Rigveda 1.113, to Usas the Dawn, who wakes the world to its work
inspired_by.note: Original composition after Rigveda 1.113, to Usas the Dawn, who wakes the world to its work. Not a translation, and not a quotation.

notes: Edited from the owner's draft: "Wake the horses" became "Wake the oxen": canon has no horse in Jambhudweep.
sources: the owner's draft of nomadic-migration sayings for the cutscenes, 2026-10-01
